title: Constant fibre dimension near a zero-dimensional fibre stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and $U\subseteq T$ an open such that $f|_U$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $x\in X$ with $f(x)\in U$, and assume that the local ring of the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_{f(x)}$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] at $x$ has Krull dimension zero [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Then there exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq X$ of $x$, lying over $U$, such that for every $y\in V$ the local topological dimension of $X_{f(y)}$ at $y$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is $n$. The integer $n$ need not be zero.

source.place: Tags 045U, 02NM and 02NJ; dimension-zero-stalk special case of the local neighbourhood construction in Tag 054T

proof.text: Restrict the morphism over U. The fibre at f(x) is canonically isomorphic to the original fibre: the residue field is unchanged by open restriction, and pullback associativity identifies the two fibres. Its local rings therefore agree. The fibre is locally Noetherian by the restricted-fibre theorem. The dimension-zero fibre local ring is Artinian and Cohen-Macaulay: the empty regular sequence attains its dimension zero.

Tag 045U makes the Cohen-Macaulay locus of the restricted flat locally finitely presented morphism open. Restrict the source to this locus. Its fibres are Cohen-Macaulay and the morphism remains flat and locally finitely presented. Tag 02NM decomposes it into open-and-closed pieces of pure relative dimension n. Choose the piece containing x. Its image V in X is open because the source and target restriction inclusions are open immersions, and lies over U.

The fibres of the chosen piece are equidimensional of dimension n (Tag 02NJ). In a scheme locally of finite type over a field with equidimensional fibres of dimension n, every nonempty open neighbourhood of a point has dimension n: shrink to a finite-type affine neighbourhood and use that nonempty opens of each component preserve its dimension. Thus local topological dimension on each fibre of the piece is n. These fibre inclusions are open immersions into the original fibres, so the infimum over open neighbourhoods is unchanged. This gives the asserted equality at every y in V.

proof_origin.place: Tags 045U and 02NM, as combined in Tag 054T; open-restriction and local-dimension transport expanded by M1

theorem exists_constant_fibre_dimension_neighbourhood_of_stalk_dimension_zero
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (x : X) (hx : f x ∈ U)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber x)) = 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, f y ∈ U ∧ topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
